text:
ria: quick RFC follow-up about onboarding micro-bench orchestration. yesterday's separate mini-bench runners caused duplicated work and flaky sample selection. thinking we should centralize a Mini-Bench Coordinator (MBC) that mediates intake -> bench handoff and enforces sampling contracts.

sam: sounds good. bottleneck today is multiple services each picking ad-hoc sample sets. MBC would provide: 1) canonical stratified sampler, 2) lightweight pre-check hooks, 3) backpressure signals to intake to avoid bench storming.

maria: +1. important interfaces: intake posts descriptor + hinted-trust-level, MBC returns probe_job_id and mode (shadow, enforce, skip) and a small sample manifest. That way benches are reproducible.

leo: operational constraints: keep MBC stateless where possible. sampler config can be a versioned proto in catalog; MBC just returns sample refs (pointer to catalog lists) instead of embedding samples. Also emit events mbc.request, mbc.decision, mbc.latency.

ria: tradeoffs: centralization reduces duplication but is a single point of failure. Proposal: MBC runs as multi-zone service with a cached local sampler in intake lambda for short outages. If MBC unreachable, intake falls back to deterministic sampler and marks event mbc.fallback.

sam: policy bits: intake descriptor includes "sampling_tier": "fast"|"standard"|"deep" and "enforce_checks": [true|false]. MBC maps tiers to sample budgets and probe templates.

maria: for backwards-compat, MBC should accept a "replay_id" param so benches can request exact sample manifests for later replay. Also add checksum of manifest to prevent silent drift.

leo: telemetry: track canary_noise_reduction, bench_dup_rate, avg_samples_per_intake, and mbc_miss_count. These drive auto-adjust for sample budgets.

ria: rollout plan: 1) prototype MBC returning sample refs and pre-check verdicts in shadow for 7d at 3% traffic, 2) add intake local cache, 3) enable backpressure signals for large intake bursts, 4) flip to primary.

sam: owner list: sam proto service + intake client, maria handles replay/manifest checksums, leo telemetry + ops fallback, ria owns rollout doc. I'll sketch API today: POST /v1/probe-request {descriptor, sampling_tier, trust_hint} -> {probe_job_id, mode, manifest_ref, checksum}.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-4915 and scheduled shadow window 4831300000-4831980000.

maria: minor note: manifest_ref should be stable across catalog changes. use content-addressed storage (CAS) for manifests.

leo: good call. also add "suggested_fallback_variant" in decision payload when pre-check warns. intake UI can show quick-swap.

ria: OK. sync tomorrow after proto so we can validate replayability and metrics. short action list: sam -> proto, maria -> CAS + replay hooks, leo -> telemetry + UI unblock, ria -> rollout sheet.

sam: ack.
